stallFinding: An earlier stale blocked state persisted after user approval. Subsequent work shipped, but the remaining queue expanded from the bounded consolidation pilot into general source and catalog review. Close independently deployable batches and distinguish implementation completion from later Google observation.

currentBatch.problem: A production river hub showed Recommended today on a route whose actual readiness call was Skip today. Default ordering compared raw scores before decision gates.
currentBatch.change: Use the existing public decision and availability semantics for recommendation eligibility, default ranking and ready-count copy. Rank paddle before watch before skip; retain raw score as a secondary ordering factor. Planning and unavailable routes cannot receive a recommendation.
currentBatch.scope: Browser river-hub ranking and badge only; no route publication, endpoint, geometry, gauge, threshold or numerical scoring changes.

localValidation.browserCoverage: Desktop and iPhone: skip/watch/withheld, ready versus higher raw score, planning/offline, planning-only, explicit sort, and existing API-failure fallback.
localValidation.builtIndexabilityAudit: passed with no errors or warnings

currentBatch.releaseAcceptance: Merge and deploy the exact reviewed commit to frontend and API static fallback. Confirm the public West Canada hub does not recommend a skip/watch/unavailable/planning route, inspect the deployed bundle on both serving origins, and preserve the current consolidation targets and sitemap inventory. Local tests alone are not publication evidence.
